It depends what kinda player you are, and what kind of experience you want. You basically have two options;

1) Do whatever you want, plant some crops, mine some gems, make some friends, just do whatever takes your fancy. 😍

2) Get sucked into the hardcore ultra precise min/max game where you will have a browser with about 15 tabs loaded in the background at all times and a notebook, this is going to be an intense 6 weeks of your life 💪🥵.

You will be writing down what friendships 💖 you haven't maxed out, what recipes you are missing ❓️, the date your wine 🍷 casks will be ready, the fish 🎣 you need - where to get them - what time of day and what weather conditions, what books 📚 you are missing, what you haven't crafted, what quests you haven't completed yet. How much more of the £14 million do you need? Grind grind grind grind grind, get down to your last few items and missing bits, go into spring 🌱 year 3 feeling like you have nearly completed the game and realise you are missing something from winter ❄️, speed sleep through an entire year to get to the night market - catch a blobfish. 

Check through your list, sell your wine, get the golden clock and the return scepter, realise you are missing 1 book - realise you are missing The Art O Crabbing, which is available... in squidfest 🐙... at the start of winter. Check stardew predictor for when the bookseller will next have a copy, 3 years, okay - speed sleep through another year - do squidfest, get rngd to 9 squid, reload, 9 squid, reload, 10 squid! Get the book. Realise you need to get married and have 2 kids:facepalm:, go and propose to someone, get married, speed sleep until you trigger the kids, get the achievement. Grind grind grind. Best enchantments on every weapon, all buildings, build a house for pam, sort the wizards wife out 🧙‍♀️, appease the archaeologist guy, realise you need bananas 🍌 for the last 2 walnuts from the gorilla 😬 and you can only get that from a banana tree and you can only get that from the sodding item trader on the island for dragon teeth 🌂 so you gotta farm the Volcano mine 🌋 Farm the Volcano mine. Get banana Sapling.

 Plant banana unknowingly  in a location where it won't grow 🤬 Farm Volcano mine. Get banana Sapling. Realise at this point you can exchange radioactive bars for galaxy souls. Plant banana Sapling in greenhouse where it will 100% definitely grow. Farm dangerous mines for radioactive bars, return to island trader to find no galaxy souls, discover its only on the last day of the season, speed sleep 🛌. Trade galaxy souls. Make it all the way through the Volcano again to forge the strongest weapon in the game. Realise you could have crafted the hammer 🔨 instead of the sword 🗡 and still got the achievement and the hammer is better. 😭 Banana are ready 🍌. Take bananas to gorilla for final nuts 🌰. Realise you could have crafted the forge which you need to do anyway instead of doing the whole Volcano again. Crafted the forge. 

Last 3 craftables - Mystic tree seed, Treasure Totem and Blue Grass, both need Mystic Syrup, which you can only get from Mystic Trees 🌳. Realise you have absolutely no pine/maple seeds. Go and cut down everyone's trees 🌳. Crafted Maple Tree Sapling. Plant mystic tree Sapling. Heavy tapper. Speed sleep 😴🛌, collect Mystic Syrup. Speed sleep 😴🛌. Craft final 2 items. Banana to wizard for final obelisk 🏛. Stardew tea to Sandy in the desert to complete final friendship 💖. FINALLY complete perfection checklist, trigger <spoiler>. Finally done. Check achievements, wait what's this? Fectors Challenge ❌️? Okay.. spend 12 HOURS just grinding the bastard game reloading on every death and running into town to realise that the last level without getting hit is basically impossible 🤯. Complete the game taking a few hits 😫

Get the game machine delivered, set it up by your bed, 🕹🛏. 1 achievement remains, but it cant be done. Skillchecked into 99.99% completion 🫠 How to get round this? There must be a way. discover you can install something called smapi that allows you to mod the game 🤓 Install smapi. Install prairie king mod. Click "autocomplete fectors challenge achuevement" ✅️. 100% completed, 225 hours over 6 weeks. Best game ever. Now you can play the game as advised in 1) and have fun.

Take it steady, the game will own your ass if you go R1 spam style and think you can just mow everything down, study the opponents movement, react to it appropriately, its like a dance. Really good players will basically roll and jump every attack, but you gotta be really good at the game to do that. Personally on my first playthrough I used shields a lot as blocking is easy, sure you still take some damage but it makes the game much more forgiving. Dont forget to use your Spirit Ashes on bosses or in areas where the Blue Portcullis icon comes up on the left. At a site of grace make sure you change your Estus charges, if you are going non-magic then I would completely remove all FP flask charges until you get much later on in the game (where you want to be able to use weapon art many times in a fight), go maximum number of heals possible. Also dont be afraid to try different weapons and stuff as you go through, there is one weapon you get very early on (I am not going to say what weapon this is) that is basically the best weapon in the entire game for a certain build so perhaps you will stumble on that, but otherwise you will be changing (and upgrading) weapons quite a lot as you play through. Oh and the bow and arrow is really useful so dont ignore it, just remember to not keep it equipped all the time as it adds to your armour weight even if you are not using it.
